title: 今回だけはどうしても

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Partway through the summer camp, I learn that the younger racer I've been so enamored with won't get to run in the autumn Tenno Sho—just because there aren't enough slots.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It feels like it's my fault—like I'm getting in the way of my oshis. I'm feeling like I should never have debuted at all, when my trainer reminds me…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The pain Umamusume feel today becomes their strength tomorrow. They can overcome any difficulty! And that's why I love them so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I know the younger racer will get over this. That's why I can't let it bring me down!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll race with all my strength for her. I'll take all the passion of every Umamusume I've ever raced against and use it to confront Opera O and Doto!
